summary_markdown: A discussion addressed the potential issue of facility data structure where two terminals (T1 and T2) within an airport are categorized as separate groups (Airport_T1, Airport_T2), but their master category remains 'Airport'. The concern was whether this separation would cause problems in analytics. It was noted that having a prefix like 'Airport%' in the master category generally allows clustering on 'Airport Analytics'. Specifically regarding session timeout, it was suggested that setting a 2-hour limit for airports would resolve potential issues because all participants' categories would match 'Airport%'.
decisions: The current facility categorization structure (T1/T2 under master Airport) is deemed unlikely to cause major analytical problems.
